lines.t: (Verse 1)
(Clean, melodic guitar picking)
The sky begins to tremble in the east
The shadows fade, the lowest are the least
I feel the thunder rolling through the air
I’m standing still, I know that You are there
The weight of glory’s breaking through the night
I’m reaching out to catch the morning light
(Pre-Chorus)
The veil is thin, the wait is almost done
The Daughter looks toward the Rising Sun
(Verse 1)
I’ve left the shadows far behind,
Ready for the world to turn.
With a steady hand and an open mind,
For every lesson left to learn.
(Chorus)
I’m tracing lines across the sky,
Reaching out to touch the light.
Watching all the ghosts pass by,
As the morning breaks the night.
(Verse 2)
Beneath the glow of a rising sun,
Finding where my heart belongs.
With every step, a life begun,
And echoes of a thousand songs.
(Chorus)
I’m tracing lines across the sky,
Reaching out to touch the light.
Watching all the ghosts pass by,
As the morning breaks the night.
(Bridge)
(Building intensity, soaring vocals)
I’m waiting on the breath of life
I’m waiting for the end of strife
The Bride is ready, the Spirit calls
The fire of Your presence falls!
(Guitar Solo - Melodic and powerful)
(Chorus)
I’m tracing lines across the sky,
Reaching out to touch the light.
Watching all the ghosts pass by,
As the morning breaks the night.
(Outro)
The rhythm finds a way to mend,
A brand new path around the bend.
No more looking back at where I’ve been,
Just letting all the light rush in.
(Fade out)
